failedRunsPreserved.cause: WebGPU renderer revalidated recorded draws at end(); validateDrawTextures returned a stages field that its own record() check then rejected ("unsupported texture binding field: stages"). Fixed in guest-vulkan-graphics/renderer.mjs.
guest.html expected uniformUploads:1 (guess); the ICD uploads the UBO once per submitted pass (12). All pixel rounds had passed on NVIDIA. Expected value corrected to 12.
bad-separate rejection regex in check-translators.mjs; fixed, run2 passes
